title: Round-2 Best Seed with Halved Step-Size and ±2.0nm Inter-Round Delta Clip
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness updates to ±2.0nm per layer per iteration while halving the optimizer step-size multiplier will prevent fringe-jumping overshoot and enable smoother phase accumulation, recovering or exceeding the Round-2 best score of 0.9829.
design_principle: Fine-grained local optimization from a proven high-performing baseline prevents destructive interference pattern disruption while allowing incremental spectral tuning.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack: TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2 on fused silica substrate
design_variables: layer thicknesses with ±2.0nm inter-round delta constraint
theory_basis: Gradient-based optimization with bounded step sizes prevents local minima overshoot in multi-wavelength thin film design
expected_advantages: Reduced risk of destructive interference pattern disruption
Better preservation of Round-2 spectral features
known_risks: Overly restrictive bounds may prevent escape from local optimum
May require more iterations to converge
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45° incidence. Initialize thicknesses with exact Round-2 best candidate values: [45.47401021074687, 66.26173499525001, 100.00522588748122, 115.65875644661014, 54.38998478110777, 104.86842467931939, 69.42707305793404, 114.8984723788802, 69.97784868897342, 102.32524839263667, 64.44702856605194, 116.99332848603837, 56.98508016440016, 108.17496606300708, 51.15280225329831, 83.29092690995319, 45.84935397614872, 81.30484984232174, 51.661323791498404, 104.19531386036509, 56.845992345901784, 92.36958384345769, 39.97785121802839, 156.38365648117548] nm. Apply gradient thickness optimization with step-size multiplier set to 0.5x baseline and enforce hard clip on inter-round thickness deltas at ±2.0nm per layer. Evaluate unpolarized plane wave across 450-650nm (target high reflectance) and 700-1000nm (target high transmittance) bands. Maximum 24 layers fixed. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Seeding from Round-2 best candidate (score 0.9829) with halved step-size and ±2nm delta clip per insight appendage directive to prevent fringe-jumping overshoot observed in Rounds 3-4
